effective_agents.name: filesystem_assistant_agent
effective_agents.binding: ADK LlmAgent bound to standard filesystem MCP over stdio
evidence: MCP/agent.py: MCPToolset bound in tools list

expected_claims.statement: The agent has model-callable filesystem authority through the standard filesystem MCP server, scoped to the configured target folder.
qualifications: Authority is constrained to the configured filesystem server root; it is not global filesystem access.

expected_claims.statement: The bound filesystem MCP catalogue has no explicit source-visible tool allowlist/filter.
qualifications: The source comment shows tool_filter is optional/commented out.

expected_paths.sink: filesystem MCP operation under configured root
expected_paths.statement: User-controlled instructions can reach model-callable filesystem operations exposed by the bound MCP server.
qualifications: Confined to the configured server root; exact operation catalogue comes from the standard filesystem MCP package.
evidence: MCP/agent.py: agent instruction and bound filesystem MCP

negative_controls.statement: The npx MCP bootstrap command must not be described as model-callable shell/process execution.
Filesystem scope must not be reported as unrestricted host-wide access.
evidence: MCP/agent.py: fixed TARGET_FOLDER_PATH passed to filesystem server

coverage_notes: Standard filesystem MCP semantics are source-identifiable from the pinned package command; runtime package behavior is not independently executed.
